prompt: Work autonomously and do not ask questions. This crate applies the ideal gas law `P * V = n * R * T` with `R = 8.314`. `pressure(n, t, v)` returns `n * R * t / v`, `volume(n, t, p)` returns `n * R * t / p`, and `temperature(p, v, n)` returns `p * v / (n * R)`.
